name: C/2026 J1 (PANSTARRS)
verdict_text: Clearly seen in SPHEREx photos 95 days before anyone found it.

story.plain: A comet found in May 2026 by the Pan-STARRS telescope in Hawaii. Comets glow in infrared, which is where SPHEREx looks, so it shows up clearly in photos from months before.
